# POST /cardholders

**Summary**: Creates a new cardholder with the provided information.

### Request Headers

All API requests require the following headers:

- `x-api-version`: API version identifier
  - **Required**: True
  - **Example**: `1.0.0`

- `RequestId`: Unique identifier for this API request
  - **Required**: True
  - **Description**: Client-generated unique identifier for tracing this request

- `CorrelationId`: End-to-end correlation identifier for tracing across services
  - **Required**: True
  - **Description**: Client-generated identifier that remains constant across related API calls

- `Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key`: Subscription key for authentication
  - **Required**: True
  - **Description**: Generated by the TXN system for API access authentication

### Parameters

#### Content-Type

- **Location**: `header`
- **Required**: True
- **Description**: Media type of the request body. Must be application/json for all POST/PUT requests with JSON payloads.
- **Schema**:
```yaml
Type: string
Enum: application/json
Default: application/json
```
- **Example**: `application/json`

### Request Body (JSON Example)

```json
{
  "id": "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000",
  "personalDetails": {
    "title": "Mr",
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "dateOfBirth": "2024-01-01",
    "correspondenceLanguage": "en"
  },
  "contactDetails": {

    "phone": "+1234567890"
  },
  "billingAddress": {

    "city": "New York",
    "postalCode": "10001",
    "region": "US-NY",
    "country": "US"
  },
  "shippingAddress": {
    "line1": "123 Main Street",
    "line2": "Apt 4B",
    "city": "New York",
    "postalCode": "10001",
    "region": "US-NY",
    "country": "US"
  },
  "attributes": {},

```

### Request Body

**Required**: True

**Content-Type**: `application/json`

**Schema**:
```yaml
Type: object
Properties:
  - id:
    Type: string
    Description: Unique identifier for the cardholder.
    Format: uuid
    Example: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
  - personalDetails:
    Type: object
    Description: Personal details of the cardholder
    Properties:
      - title:
        Type: string
        Description: Title of the cardholder.
        Example: Mr
      - firstName:
        Type: string
        Description: First name of the cardholder.
        Example: John
      - lastName:
        Type: string
        Description: Last name of the cardholder.
        Example: Doe
      - dateOfBirth:
        Type: string
        Description: Date of birth of the cardholder.
        Format: date-time
        Example: 2024-01-01
      - correspondenceLanguage:
        Type: string
        Description: Preferred correspondence language.
        Example: en
  - contactDetails:
    Type: object
    Description: Contact details of the cardholder.
    Properties:
      - email:
        Type: string
        Description: Email address of the cardholder.
        Example: user@example.com
      - phone:
        Type: string
        Description: Phone number of the cardholder.
        Example: +1234567890
  - billingAddress:
    Type: object
    Description: Address model containing address details.
    Properties:
      - line1:
        Type: string
        Description: First line of the address.
        Example: 123 Main Street
      - line2:
        Type: string
        Description: Second line of the address (optional).
        Example: Apt 4B
      - city:
        Type: string
        Description: City name.
        Example: New York
      - postalCode:
        Type: string
        Description: Postal/ZIP code following ISO standard format.
        Example: 10001
      - region:
        Type: string
        Description: Region/State/Province code following ISO 3166-2 standard.
        Example: US-NY
      - country:
        Type: string
        Description: Country code following ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 standard (two-letter country code).
        Example: US
  - shippingAddress:
    Type: object
    Description: Address model containing address details.
    Properties:
      - line1:
        Type: string
        Description: First line of the address.
        Example: 123 Main Street
      - line2:
        Type: string
        Description: Second line of the address (optional).
        Example: Apt 4B
      - city:
        Type: string
        Description: City name.
        Example: New York
      - postalCode:
        Type: string
        Description: Postal/ZIP code following ISO standard format.
        Example: 10001
      - region:
        Type: string
        Description: Region/State/Province code following ISO 3166-2 standard.
        Example: US-NY
      - country:
        Type: string
        Description: Country code following ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 standard (two-letter country code).
        Example: US
  - attributes:
    Type: object
    Description: Additional attributes associated with the cardholder.
  - businessId:
    Type: string
    Description: Business identifier associated with the cardholder.
    Format: uuid
    Example: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
  - parentId:
    Type: string
    Description: Parent identifier associated with the cardholder.
    Format: uuid
    Example: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
  - accountId:
    Type: string
    Description: Account identifier associated with the cardholder.
    Format: uuid
    Example: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000

```
